description: Land Acquisition - Angoda Mulleriyawa, Kolonnawa D/S/D, Colombo District
categorisation: The gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act. Its primary subject is the compulsory taking of possession of specific, described parcels of land (Lots A, B, D, E, F) for a public project (Kolonnawa Storm Water Drainage and Environment Improvement Project). While it is issued by a named Minister, the core purpose and detailed content are exclusively about land matters—describing the land's location, boundaries, extent, and claimants. According to the priority rules, specialized categories (4-9) are for non-governmental administrative matters, and this content fits the definition of a Land Gazette (Type 4) perfectly.
